name: GLKVM Cloud
description: GLKVM Cloud lets individuals and small businesses manage GL.iNet KVM devices remotely from their own server. It supports access-code onboarding, in-browser remote control, batch commands, and LDAP/OIDC sign-in, keeping data and bandwidth under your control.

app_vars.name: var_glkvm_access_ip
app_vars.label: Server Access IP
app_vars.help: Public IP by default; set the internal IP when devices are on the local network

notes.text: Opening the platform by IP shows a browser certificate warning because GLKVM Cloud generates its own certificate on first start. Use your own domain and certificate to remove it.
The admin password is stored as RTTYS_PASS in /opt/glkvm-cloud-data/.env inside the container.
Allow ports 443, 10443, 5915 and 3478 (TCP and UDP) toward the container. KVM devices need firmware v1.11.0 or later for access-code onboarding.
